content: He Nengazen, is-isipa nu ke hengkey is nehitavù kenami. Ahàa nu is nepengkusan dey he kegkepeel-elezi kenami.
Is menge tanè dey wey is menge valey zey, migkuwa te menge lumelengyawà.
Nengeilu key, ne nengevalu is menge iney zey.
Kinahanglan pa he ebpemesahan dey is wahig he ed-inumen dey wey is kayu he idtavun dey.
Impeterebahu key he iring te menge uyaǥen he mid-eyuǥuwan. Ne kenè key en ibpehimeley.
Mibpesakup key te menge tig-Ehipto wey menge tig-Asiria su para lang mekekaan key.
Mibaal te salà is menge kepuun dey he nemematey en guntaan, ne iyan key nerasey tenged te salè dan.
Menge uripen is midumala kenami ne wazà ebpekepeǥawas kenami puun te ǥehem dan.
Dutun te kebpen-ehè dey te keenen nemiligru key te ermadu he menge etew ziyà te sibsivayan.
Edetengen key tenged te subra he kegkevitil, ne is menge lawa zey henduen be te keinit te rapug is keinit din.
Mibpenlayug is menge esawa zey wey menge anak dey he menge vahi ziyà te Zion wey is diyà te menge inged diyà te Juda.
Imbitey pinaaǥi te menge velad dan is menge pengulu zey, ne wazè en tehuza is menge meǥurang dey.
Is menge vetan-en dey he menge maama mibpeǥes ipepenggaling he henduen be te menge uripen, ne is menge vatà ebpemekeurambak en te kebpetianga kandan te meveǥat he menge kayu.
Is menge meǥurang wazè en mekepinuu ziyà te pultahan te inged te kebeǥey te sambag, ne is betan-en he menge maama wazè en meketukar te menge sunata.
Wazè dey en kelipey. Kenè key en ebpekesayew, kekenà, ebpekelalew key zà.
Naawè en is dengeg dey. Mekehizuhizu key su geina te nekesalà key.
Tenged kayi mibmesakit is gehinawa zey ne mibmerusirem is ked-ehè dey.
Su mekevulungbulung en is Buvungan he Zion, ne iyan dà edriǥuriǥu kayi is leew he menge asu.
He Nengazen, midhadì ka te wazà pidtemanan. Is kedhadì nu ebpedayun minsan keenu.
Maan is layun key kenikew edlipati? Maan is neuǥet en is kedselikwaya nu kenami?
He Nengazen, ipelikù key ziyà te kenikew ne edlikù key. Ilikù nu zini te kenami is meupiya he kebpekesavuk dey zutun te nehuna he timpu.
Subre en be is kegkepeuki nu kenami su maan is inselikwey key en kenikew?
